fr_html: Mr. ROOT est d'avis que la question a peu d'importance; mais on rendrait la Cour impopulaire en la rendant trop coûteuse, et il serait inutile de payer deux greffiers et le personnel de deux greffes alors qu'un seul greffe et un seul greffier pourraient suffire.
en_html: Mr. ROOT thought that the question was of little importance; but the Court would be unpopular if it were too costly, and it was quite unnecessary to pay two Registrars and a double staff, when a single Registrar and Registry would suffice.
